licensing_note: Availability varies by location, configured tier, provider terms, attribution requirements, and optional API keys. Do not assume all source families are active at every coordinate.
static_layer_policy: Large static products such as DEM, bathymetry, land cover, buildings, coastline, and satellite scenes must be precomputed, tiled, cached, or fetched asynchronously. Public request handlers should read compact spot summaries only. Coarse regional bathymetry such as GEBCO is not a navigation chart and cannot identify spot-scale reefs, sandbars, or obstructions.
